dependencyRationale: The Android-host adapter test compiles the canonical monetization adapter against ProductSettings and MapSettings; only its test source set and matching dependency classpath are writable.
fallbackReason: The adapter crosses the monetization/data module boundary, so their common contracts are fingerprint inputs while writes remain limited to two paths.
toolchainIdentity: Gradle wrapper 9.5.1; JDK 17; Kotlin 2.4.10; Multiplatform Settings 1.3.0
